title: game of life
how: random binary matrix - an empty cell with 3 live neighbours comes alive / creates objects - objects sit, blink, or move, depending on their shape

title: rule 90
how: random row of 1s and 0s - each new cell is its left neighbour xor its right / the rows stack - triangles inside triangles appear on their own

title: rule 110
how: random row of 1s and 0s - each new cell looks itself + its 2 neighbours up in an 8-rule table / the rows stack - particles appear and crash into each other

title: mandelbrot
how: every pixel is a number c - repeat z = z² + c / if it blows up, colour it by how fast - zoom in and the edge never ends
